faq.title: Everything you may want to know before starting.
faq.description: Practical answers about lessons, scheduling, materials and learning with CostaSpanish.

items.question: How do the live classes work?
items.answer: Our live classes are held through video calls with qualified native teachers. You only need a computer or smartphone and a stable internet connection.

items.question: Can I take a free trial lesson?
items.answer: Yes! You can book a free trial lesson to get to know our teachers, experience our method, and see if it fits your goals.

items.question: What levels do you offer?
items.answer: We offer all levels, from complete beginners (A1) to advanced (C2). Each course follows the CEFR standards for language learning.

items.question: How many students are there per class?
items.answer: Our group classes are small, with a maximum of 6 students, to ensure personalised attention and active participation.

items.question: Can I choose my own schedule?
items.answer: Yes, for private lessons you can select your preferred time slots. For group lessons, we have several schedules available depending on your level.

items.question: What platform do you use for classes?
items.answer: We use Zoom or Google Meet for live sessions. You’ll receive a direct link to each class in your student area.

items.question: Do I need to buy any materials?
items.answer: All study materials are included and accessible in your student area. You won’t need to purchase any books.

items.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a lesson?
items.answer: Yes, private lessons can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24 hours in advance. Group lessons follow a fixed schedule.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: You can contact us anytime via email at info@costaSpanishClass.com or through the chat in your student dashboard.
